directions.north: North road-facing library and community hall: broad stone steps, colonnaded entry canopy, civic notice board without readable text, two shade trees and forecourt; pale sandstone, teal doors, red-brick base, slate roof and cupola.
directions.east: Independently authored east road-facing library and community hall: accessible side entrance with shallow steps and rail, tall reading-room window wall, courtyard bench and planted forecourt; distinct roof and cupola composition.
directions.south: Independently authored south road-facing library and community hall: community-room entry and modest portico, wide arched meeting-room window, notice case without readable text, benches and planted forecourt; distinct roofline and facade rhythm.
directions.west: Independently authored west road-facing library and community hall: recessed reading-garden entrance with low colonnade, book-return vestibule without text, warm tall window bays, planted low wall and trees; distinct gables and cupola placement.
